scientific_integrity: General compound-Poisson divisibility of geometric mixtures and the general DSD criterion are credited to earlier sources, not claimed as novel. The new assertions are the exact two-neighbor classification, contiguous-failure structure and unbounded first-failure index.
scientific_limitations: Positive mixture weights and distinct parameters only; a two-index logarithmic minimizer is exact in real arithmetic. The full text of the closely titled 2025 Waza–Ahmad paper was not accessible, and no independent external audit has been performed.
title: Two-index self-decomposability criterion for two-geometric mixtures
